description: This file implements WebSocket connection management, including connection metadata handling, connection establishment, message sending, and connection closing within a WebSocket client using the websocketpp library. It defines classes for managing WebSocket connections and their states, handling events such as open, fail, close, and message reception.

classes.name: ConnectionMetaData
classes.description: Manages metadata for a WebSocket connection, including connection state, response headers, messages, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: WebSocketEndPoint
classes.description: Manages multiple WebSocket connections, handles connection lifecycle, message transmission, and event handling.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onOpen
methods.description: Handles the event when a WebSocket connection is successfully opened.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onFail
methods.description: Handles the event when a WebSocket connection fails.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onClose
methods.description: Handles the event when a WebSocket connection is closed.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages on the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket endpoint, setting up logging and threading.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up and closes all active WebSocket connections.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::connect
methods.description: Establishes a new WebSocket connection to the specified URI, optionally waiting for the connection to open.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::close
methods.description: Closes an active WebSocket connection identified by its ID.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::send
methods.description: Sends a message over an open WebSocket connection and waits for a response.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific WebSocket connection by ID.
